visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with glasses sits at a wooden table in a restaurant. She has a comedic digital filter on her face that adds thick, bushy eyebrows and a hand-drawn beard. She is wearing a dark brown top and looking directly at the camera with an expressive, talking mouth. Several white ceramic bowls with remnants of food and chopsticks are positioned on the table in front of her. The background features warm-toned wooden panels, a framed painting, and several shopping bags, including a red one and a beige tote with a cartoon print. (2) A digital water surface overlay appears horizontally across the frame. The woman begins a series of rapid, jerky movements, ducking her head below the animated water line and quickly popping back up. She uses her hands to mimic splashing or waving. Graphic elements including blue wave-like cutouts and purple rising bubbles are superimposed over the scene. She bows her head repeatedly in a fast-paced motion as if apologizing. The lighting is consistent, bright indoor lighting throughout the sequence.
